body_es: Un pipeline de CI/CD automatiza la ejecución de pruebas cada vez que se hace commit de código. Herramientas como GitHub Actions, GitLab CI y Jenkins ejecutan tests en servidores dedicados, reportan resultados y bloquean merges si falla la calidad. Un pipeline típico incluye: linting (análisis estático), tests unitarios, tests de integración, tests E2E, y análisis de cobertura. Los pipelines deben ser rápidos (feedback inmediato), confiables (sin falsos positivos) y paralelos (ejecutar tests simultáneamente). Configurar correctamente un pipeline es crucial para mantener calidad.
body_en: A CI/CD pipeline automates test execution whenever code is committed. Tools like GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, and Jenkins run tests on dedicated servers, report results, and block merges if quality fails. A typical pipeline includes: linting (static analysis), unit tests, integration tests, E2E tests, and coverage analysis. Pipelines should be fast (immediate feedback), reliable (no false positives), and parallel (run tests simultaneously). Properly configuring a pipeline is crucial for maintaining quality.
example_code:
# GitHub Actions workflow example (.github/workflows/test.yml)
name: Test Pipeline

on: [push, pull_request]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ['3.9', '3.10', '3.11']
    
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
    
    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
    
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
    
    - name: Run linting
      run: flake8 . --count --select=E9,F63,F7,F82
    
    - name: Run unit tests
      run: pytest tests/unit -v --cov
    
    - name: Run integration tests
      run: pytest tests/integration -v
example_output:
Linting: PASSED
Unit tests: 156 passed in 12s
Integration tests: 48 passed in 35s
Pipeline: SUCCESS
